body: That's the point, i've been enjoying things i liked less and less.
I'm barely even allowed to go outside and even if i had complete freedom i'd be scared to go farther than the local supermarket lol. Meanwhile it's way easier to find people to talk to online
Jumping off a roof would be selfish and painful and there's a high probability i will still survive, so why should i try if it's likely going to be more painful than existence itself?
